_note: Fixed BEFORE the multi-seed evaluation was run (2026-10-16). Do not tune the simulator or these numbers to make tests pass; report failures as found.

metric_definitions.alert: a component is in alert when 2 of its last 3 readings are at/above its own limit (0.50 on the fusion scale) -- the deployed persistence rule
metric_definitions.alert_rate_demand: share of live blocks during demand periods (excluding the first 2 min of each demand period: physiological onset) in alert
metric_definitions.false_alarm_rate_calm: share of live blocks during calm periods in alert, EXCLUDING the first 2 min after each demand period ends (grace period: realistic physiological recovery)
metric_definitions.time_to_first_alert_s: seconds from demand start to the first block in alert, per demand period (none = no alert in that period)
metric_definitions.time_to_clear_s: seconds from demand end until the component is out of alert, per demand period
metric_definitions.gate_rejection_rate: share of live EEG blocks not scored (quality gate or dropout)
metric_definitions.calibration_status: EEG: ok / drift_suspected / not_separated (direction-aware ABA rule); ring: ok / drift_suspected / not_separated
metric_definitions.fusion_weights: mean EEG and ring weight given by the fusion engine over live blocks with both inputs

early_warning._note: Fixed BEFORE the first early-warning evaluation run (2026-10-16), with the default parameters of backend/common/early_warning.py (N=6, k=4, buffer 0.5 spread, rise 0.5 spread, EWMA 0.3, persistence 2, cooldown 7). No tuning on these seeds.
early_warning.scenario: ramp (session.SCENARIOS['ramp']): calm 4 min, demand ramps 0->1 over 5 min, demand 2 min, calm 4 min, plateau of moderate load (0.4) 4 min, calm 4 min

metric_definitions.ew_sensitivity: share of HIGH episodes (2-of-3 rule) starting in a ramp/demand period (+2 min) that were preceded by an early warning within the 5 min before
metric_definitions.ew_lead_time_s: median seconds from the warning's start to that HIGH episode's start
metric_definitions.ew_precision: share of early warnings followed by HIGH within 5 min
metric_definitions.ew_false_per_hour_calm: warnings starting in calm periods (excluding the first 2 min after a non-calm period) per hour of calm
metric_definitions.mind_led_share_of_fused_high: share of fused HIGH episodes where, within the 5 min before, the mind was in early warning / high while the body was still below its limit (pre-stress signature) -- REPORTED, no pass line
metric_definitions.aggregation: per component, mean over the runs where the component was not 'limited' and the metric is defined; 95% t-interval over seeds
